covered: Exact original wildcard-prefix membership including exotic sidecars and excluded directories
Addition/deletion/rename/content rewrite/inode replacement/chmod and nested-directory changes
Transient member removal with restored names detected by directory metadata
Regular hardlinks allowed; alias mutation/addition detected; symlinks and FIFO refused
Deterministic initial capture, earlier-subtree, and final capture mutation races
Real Pins SHA256 verification, cache invalidation, dependency and leaf receipts, compiler logs, source and configuration hashes
Runtime guard called and failure retained; unchanged fresh/resumed final status distinguished
Last-bundle mutation cannot produce PASS; final errors preserved as GUARD_FAILED with exit2
Snapshot creation only after worker-pool shutdown
limitations: Fixtures are synthetic and do not claim a full source build or installed-kernel replay.
Filesystem consistency retains the stated coordinated, nonhostile-writer assumption; no arbitrary hostile change-and-restore guarantee.
scope: Synthetic temporary-filesystem and drained-final-scheduler fixtures only; no Lean process, production source, project cache, Git, or proof-acceptance claim.
